ai_summary: Here is a 2-3 sentence executive summary of the financial document:  Almondz Global Securities reported robust Q2 FY26-27 consolidated profit growth of 136.5% to Rs. 9.13 crore, primarily propelled by exceptional performance in its Green Fuel (PGIPL JV) and Infrastructure Consulting segments. While these segments drove overall growth, the core Financial Services division saw a 16.6% profit decline due to adverse capital market conditions, posing a red flag regarding its sensitivity to market volatility. Nevertheless, significant new orders in infrastructure and the expected full commissioning of the Odisha Green Fuel plant position the company for a projected 20-25% revenue and profit growth for the full fiscal year.
